items.title: Williams Sonoma (WSM) Stock May Be A Bargain On Cash Flow But Rich On Earnings
items.summary: Williams-Sonoma stock has delivered a very strong 244.2% return over the past three years, yet its valuation signals are mixed, with the Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) intrinsic value estimate pointing to roughly 16.0% upside while earnings based multiples lean expensive.
